description: A dashboard is showing wrong totals — the dataset relationship is misconfigured. Find and fix the bug.
starterCode:
-- Dashboard dataset relationship definition
-- BUG: join column names are swapped
RELATIONSHIPS = [
    {
        'left_dataset': 'orders',
        'right_dataset': 'customers',
        'left_column': 'order_id',
        'right_column': 'customer_id',
        'join_type': 'inner'
    },
    {
        'left_dataset': 'orders',
        'right_dataset': 'products',
        'left_column': 'product_id',
        'right_column': 'order_id',
        'join_type': 'left'
    }
]

-- Symptom: Customer filter shows 0 orders even for known active customers
simulatedOutput: Customer filter shows 0 orders even for known active customers
hints: Trace each join from left to right: what column in left_dataset actually matches what column in right_dataset?
The first relationship had left_column: 'order_id' but should be 'customer_id'
The second relationship joined orders.product_id to products.order_id, which is also wrong
